The live Springer page is bot-blocked (Akamai 'Client Challenge') and returned no content even via headless render. Encoded from Wayback archive snapshots of the prior BMC guidelines (content is journal-specific and unchanged by the platform migration): landing https://web.archive.org/web/20251114175758/https://arthroplasty.biomedcentral.com/submission-guidelines (Nov 2025); general formatting https://web.archive.org/web/20250530203500/https://arthroplasty.biomedcentral.com/submission-guidelines/preparing-your-manuscript ; Research https://web.archive.org/web/20250622002716/https://arthroplasty.biomedcentral.com/submission-guidelines/preparing-your-manuscript/research ; Review https://web.archive.org/web/20250622002725/https://arthroplasty.biomedcentral.com/submission-guidelines/preparing-your-manuscript/review . encoding_notes: PUBLISHER MIGRATION: journal moved from BMC (arthroplasty.biomedcentral.com) to Springer Nature Link (journal id 42836). This is the BMC-published 'Arthroplasty', official journal of the Arthroplasty Society in Asia — DISTINCT from Elsevier's 'The Journal of Arthroplasty'.

Live Springer submission-guidelines page is bot-blocked (Akamai 'Client Challenge') and unscrapable even headless; encoded from Wayback archive snapshots of the BMC guide (landing Nov 2025; article-type pages June 2025). BMC/Springer submission content is journal-specific and unchanged by the platform migration.
Journal also accepts a 'Perspective' (opinion/viewpoint) article type — no clean enum slot, so omitted from article_types.

et_al_threshold=6 derived from the guide's own Vancouver reference examples (two examples list exactly 6 authors followed by 'et al.'), not from explicit prose. Consistent with the standard Springer Nature Vancouver 'first 6 authors then et al' style.

in_text citation mark style not explicitly stated in reachable guide — the guide names 'Vancouver' style and gives reference-LIST examples but never specifies superscript vs bracket vs paren for in-text marks; left null. order=cited is inherent to the named Vancouver numbered style.

line_numbers: guide states 'Include line and page numbering' but does not specify continuous vs per-page; encoded 'continuous' as the standard interpretation. page_numbers.show=true from the same sentence. line_spacing='double' from 'Use double line spacing'. Guide also says 'Do not use page breaks in your manuscript'.
page_size null: guide references both 'A4 or Letter' for table sizing; no single page size prescribed.
journal_abbrev=nlm from 'Journal abbreviations follow Index Medicus/MEDLINE'. include_doi=true from reference examples showing DOI form.

Abstract structure differs by type: Research = Background/Methods/Results/Conclusions (+Trial registration, conditional for RCTs); Review = Background/main body/short Conclusion (unstructured within body). abstract.sections reflects the primary type (Research). Both types cap abstract at 350 words.
No manuscript word-count limit, reference count limit, figure count or table count limit is stated for any article type (BMC does not restrict length) — all left null.

Blinding all-false: peer-review-policy page not separately fetched, but the title page (full author names + institutional addresses + corresponding author) is the first section of the single submitted manuscript with no anonymized version required — indicates single-blind review and no separate title-page file.

figures.separate_files=true: 'Figures ... uploaded in this order', individual figure files <=10 MB. legends_location='in_text': figure titles (<=15 words) and legends (<=300 words) 'should be provided in the main manuscript, not in the graphic file' — exact placement (inline vs dedicated section) unspecified. min_dpi=300 from 'image resolution of approximately 300 dpi ... at the final size'. Figure formats also include BMP, MS Word, PowerPoint, CDX (no enum slot); listed enum subset only.

tables.placement='in_text': small tables (< one A4/Letter page) placed within the manuscript, larger tables at the end of the text file. caption_position='above' from 'Table titles ... included above the table' (legends underneath). numbering='arabic' from 'Arabic numerals (Table 1, Table 2)'.

Declarations: all listed subheadings are mandatory ('All manuscripts must contain the following sections ... include the heading and write Not applicable' if not relevant). 'Consent for publication' mapped to patient_consent; 'Competing interests' to conflict_of_interest; 'Availability of data and materials' to data_availability. 'Authors' information' is optional (no enum slot; omitted).
guidelines_url set to the live Springer canonical URL (where authors are directed now) for freshness re-checks; actual encoding source is the BMC Wayback snapshots named in source_note.
[schema-required default] references.in_text defaulted to 'bracket' (guide did not state the in-text citation marker; schema requires a value; inferred from reference style 'vancouver').
